en: Novelist Kim Young-ha
once said this on TV:
"What I learned after turning forty
is that friends don't matter much."
Half right, half wrong.

text:
그래서 술친구에 너무 많이
*시간*을 낭비했다는 거예요
en: He said he wasted too much time on drinking buddies.
That part is true, but
then he says:
"If I'd slept or read books instead,
I'd be better off now."
What is he talking about?
The individual: personal growth, personal skill.
In the age of AI, what we want
is quick answers,
and the result is the extinction of experience.

text:
친구들과, 술 친구들과
술 먹고 놀면서
en: Drinking and hanging out with friends,
you learn social skills and more, together.
Without what we learn when person meets person,
the belief that on my own ability
I can live well —
that neoliberal idea sits underneath,
and many people agree with it.
We want to build our skills alone

text:
먹고 사랑하고 기도하며
살고 싶은 거예요
en: and just eat, love and pray.
But then life loses its meaning.
Life loses its meaning.
